title: Add-on marketplace index (marketplace.json, orch.market/1)
description: docs/architecture/orch-v2-marketplace.md section 3. Strict: unknown keys are refused at every level. The schema is necessary, not sufficient: duplicate ids, sorted capabilities, the signature and every rule of sections 5 to 10 are checked by the installer, in the order of section 5.

version.description: index version, raised by one or more at every change; a lower version than the last one seen is a rollback

source.description: where this index lives; must equal the URL the owner added it from

expires_at.description: unix seconds; required and signed for the official index. A stale index is shown as stale, it does not block (section 3.1)

revoked.description: id@version pairs that must not be installed or kept; covered by the index signature (section 3.1)

signature.description: sig = Sign(key, 'orch/market/1/index|' || cj({market, version, expires_at, entries: [[id, version, package_sha256]] by id, revoked})). Required for the official index, with the key pinned in core

gitUrl.description: https only; a dotted lower-case DNS name whose last label is letters (so no IP literal in any notation and no 'localhost'); no port (443 only), no credentials, query or fragment; every path segment starts with a letter or digit (so no '.' or '..'); no '.git' suffix (one repo, one URL). Lower-case paths on the case-insensitive hosts are a rule of the installer (canonical_market_url, section 4.1). Which hosts are allowed is a rule of the installer (section 5.1), not of the schema

coreVersion.description: same grammar as min_core in addon-api.md section 2

b64uKey.description: 65-byte uncompressed P-256 point, canonical unpadded base64url

subdir.description: relative POSIX path; every segment follows the package file-name rule of ticket-format 8.1, so no '..', no leading dot

commit.description: a full git object id; never a branch, a tag or an abbreviation

package_sha256.description: the ticket-format 8.1 package digest of the directory at source.subdir in commit

api.description: display only; the manifest's api range decides

lock.description: path of the lockfile inside the package

publisher.description: optional; sig = Sign(key, 'orch/market/1/entry|' || cj({'entry': entry with publisher reduced to {key}, 'market': the marketplace source URL}))
